name: API key / Bearer HTTP
description: Call APIs using a privately stored Bearer token, bound to exactly one approved origin. For example, a narrowly scoped GitHub token.
permissions: Use your Bearer credential only at the approved HTTPS origin
Read JSON; optional write requests need separate approval
docs: App: import { plugins } from '@morph/plugins'; await plugins.call('bearer-http','request',{url:'https://api.github.com/user'}). First ask the user to install/approve this plugin and enter a narrowly scoped token in the protected Plugins panel. Never ask them to paste a token into chat or app source. The broker injects Authorization: Bearer privately. Exactly one HTTPS origin may be approved. To change origins, remove the plugin (which clears its credential), then reinstall. GET is default; writes require a separate approval. No arbitrary headers or redirects. Keys sent as query parameters or other auth schemes are not supported yet. Source and agent never receive the stored token.

request.description: Read JSON from the approved API with private Bearer authentication; optionally write when granted.
